Group Tickets Group tickets can be purchased for any main stage performance throughout our season. All groups of ten or more receive a discounted ticket rate. Off Peak Season Ticket Packages are subject to a $10 per ticket upgrade fee when moving to a Peak performance (Friday, Saturday matinee and evening, and Sunday matinee). The 5 Ticket Student Package can be used all at once (all five tickets at one performance) or in any combination you desire.
